teachingReview.heading: Stop unsafe substitution
teachingReview.before: Posaconazole formulations are explicitly non-substitutable. A product switch requires a new indication, eligibility, dose, administration, and monitoring verification rather than a copied milligram amount.
teachingReview.after: Conventional posaconazole oral suspension is not substitutable with delayed-release tablets or PowderMix. A product switch requires a new indication, eligibility, dose, administration, and monitoring verification rather than a copied milligram amount. The February 2026 NOXAFIL label specifies delayed-release tablets for invasive aspergillosis treatment or high-risk prophylaxis in patients aged at least two years who weigh more than 40 kg. PowderMix covers those indications in children aged at least two years weighing 10 to 40 kg. Conventional oral suspension covers high-risk prophylaxis and oropharyngeal candidiasis in patients aged at least 13 years. Follow the exact product and indication rather than transferring one eligibility rule to every formulation. PowderMix is contraindicated in known or suspected hereditary fructose intolerance and requires its kit-specific preparation and provided notched-tip syringes.
teachingReview.source: Current NOXAFIL1/2/5.10/7.1/7.3/12.3 Absorption/17 as applicable; source-specific instructions and qualified intake/delivery planning.

teachingReview.heading: Use the current tablet instruction
teachingReview.before: Delayed-release tablets are swallowed whole and may be taken with or without food. This differs from older generalized teaching that every posaconazole dose must accompany a meal.
teachingReview.after: Delayed-release tablets are swallowed whole and may be taken with or without food. This differs from older generalized teaching that every posaconazole dose must accompany a meal. Do not divide, crush, or chew the tablets. For eligible patients who cannot eat a full meal, the label favors tablets over conventional suspension for prophylaxis because tablets generally provide higher exposure. Food flexibility does not guarantee absorption: monitor for breakthrough infection with severe diarrhea or vomiting. The tablet food study still found an exposure change with a high-fat meal.
teachingReview.source: Current NOXAFIL1/2/5.10/7.1/7.3/12.3 Absorption/17 as applicable; source-specific instructions and qualified intake/delivery planning.

teachingReview.heading: Protect suspension absorption
teachingReview.before: Oral suspension is given with a full meal or, when needed, a nutritional supplement or acidic carbonated beverage. Poor intake, acid suppression, mucositis, diarrhea, and tube feeding can undermine exposure.
teachingReview.after: Oral suspension is given with a full meal or, when needed, a nutritional supplement or acidic carbonated beverage. Give each conventional suspension dose during or within 20 minutes after a full meal. If a full meal is not possible and tablets or injection are not options, use the labeled liquid nutritional supplement or acidic carbonated beverage, such as ginger ale. If these cannot be tolerated either, consider an alternative antifungal or closely monitored suspension therapy. Shake well and use the provided measured dosing spoon. Assess poor intake, acid suppression, nausea, mucositis, diarrhea, and tube feeding before relying on oral delivery. Cimetidine and esomeprazole can lower suspension exposure; severe diarrhea or vomiting requires breakthrough monitoring. A healthy-volunteer NG-tube study found lower suspension exposure, but does not define every tube or continuous-feed protocol. Mucositis and nausea prompt intake assessment rather than a claimed uniform pharmacokinetic effect. PowderMix has separate with-food instructions and kit-specific preparation.

before.question: Which principle best characterizes posaconazole suspension administration?
choices: Oral suspension is given with a full meal or, when needed, a nutritional supplement or acidic carbonated beverage
Every systemic triazole can cause clinically important liver injury, with different clearance and label details
Additional ring nitrogen generally improves fungal CYP selectivity relative to early imidazoles but does not eliminate human CYP interactions
Itraconazole capsules, oral solution, and SUBA products differ in bioavailability and are not interchangeable
before.rationale: Low or variable suspension exposure can cause prophylaxis or treatment failure

after.question: Which principle best characterizes posaconazole suspension administration?
choices: Oral suspension is given with a full meal or, when needed, a nutritional supplement or acidic carbonated beverage
Conventional oral suspension is routinely taken fasting like the delayed-release tablet
Any clear drink makes fasting suspension exposure equivalent to a full meal
Adding an acidic beverage removes the need to review interacting drugs or breakthrough risk
after.rationale: Give conventional NOXAFIL oral suspension during or within 20 minutes after a full meal. When a full meal cannot be eaten and tablets or injection are not options, the label permits a liquid nutritional supplement or an acidic carbonated beverage such as ginger ale. Routine fasting, an arbitrary clear drink, or using a beverage to bypass interaction and breakthrough review does not follow that plan. PowderMix is a separate delayed-release product with its own with-food and preparation instructions.
